# 04 完整稽核、進度計算、證據治理與正式匯報規範

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S000 -->
## 0. 規範目的

本文件定義如何稽核專案真實狀態、驗證施工完整度、管理 Evidence、計算進度、管理 Gap / Blocker，並產出一致、可追溯的正式進度報告。

稽核的目的不是證明做了很多，而是證明 REQUIRED 項目是否真的完成。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S001 -->
## 1. 稽核最高原則

所有稽核 MUST 遵守：

- EVIDENCE BEFORE CLAIM
- CURRENT STATE BEFORE HISTORY
- CURRENT REVISION BEFORE OLD PASS
- PRODUCTION EVIDENCE BEFORE PRODUCTION CLAIM
- CLOSURE BEFORE 100%
- NO EVIDENCE = NOT VERIFIED
- PARTIAL != COMPLETE
- DEPLOYED != PRODUCTION VERIFIED
- NO DOUBLE COUNTING
- NO HIDDEN FAILURE

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S001A -->
## 1A. 變更後重新驗證原則

本文件永久適用於所有後續 Change Request。

任何會實質影響既有 Implementation、Design、Contract、Runtime、Database、Permission、Integration、Test 或 Deployment 的變更，MUST 使受影響的既有 PASS 項目失效並進入：

`REVERIFY_REQUIRED`

舊 Revision、舊 Build、舊 Test、舊 Deployment 或舊 Production PASS MUST_NOT 自動證明新 Revision 仍 PASS。

只有重新取得對應 Current Revision Evidence 後，相關項目才能恢復 PASS。

Progress MAY 因 Regression、變更或舊 Evidence 失效而下降。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S002 -->
## 2. Current Truth 不得依賴 AI 記憶

正式稽核 MUST 以當前可驗證來源為依據，不得只使用：

- 歷史聊天敘述
- AI 記憶
- 過往 Summary
- 未重新驗證的舊報告

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S003 -->
## 3. Truth Source Priority

發生 Current State 衝突時 SHOULD 依序考慮：

1. Current Production Runtime Evidence
2. Current Production Data Evidence
3. Actual Deployed Revision
4. Current Source Revision
5. Current Authority / Contract
6. Current Test Evidence
7. Historical Evidence
8. Narrative Description

產品設計 Authority 與「實際現在跑的是什麼」屬不同問題；稽核 MUST 同時指出兩者是否一致。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S004 -->
## 4. Audit 類型

正式 Audit 至少分為：

- `PRE_WORK_AUDIT`
- `WORK_UNIT_AUDIT`
- `MODULE_AUDIT`
- `SYSTEM_AUDIT`
- `RELEASE_AUDIT`
- `DEPLOYMENT_AUDIT`
- `PRODUCTION_AUDIT`
- `FINAL_ACCEPTANCE_AUDIT`
- `PERIODIC_PROGRESS_AUDIT`

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S005 -->
## 5. Audit Classification

Audit Item 狀態只能使用：

- `PASS`
- `PARTIAL`
- `FAIL`
- `BLOCKED`
- `NOT_APPLICABLE`
- `NOT_VERIFIED`

禁止使用模糊狀態。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S006 -->
## 6. PASS 定義

只有在：

- Requirement 明確。
- Required Implementation 存在。
- Required Evidence 存在，且其 exact bytes 已通過適用 parser 與 schema / required-field validation；僅檔案存在不構成有效 Evidence。
- Required Test / Verification PASS。
- 無已知直接缺口。
- 若該項要求 Production，存在 Production Evidence。

才能 PASS。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S007 -->
## 7. PARTIAL 定義

部分實作或部分 Evidence 存在，但 REQUIRED 閉環尚未完整時 MUST 為 PARTIAL。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S008 -->
## 8. FAIL 定義

已有明確 Evidence 證明不符合 Requirement 時 MUST 為 FAIL。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S009 -->
## 9. BLOCKED 定義

存在明確外部或上游阻塞條件時 MAY 為 BLOCKED，但 MUST 記錄：

- Blocker UID
- Reason
- Impact
- Unlock Condition
- Severity
- Owner

BLOCKED 不等於 PASS。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S010 -->
## 10. NOT_VERIFIED 定義

沒有足夠 Evidence 時 MUST 為 NOT_VERIFIED。

MUST_NOT 因「理論上應該正常」改成 PASS。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S011 -->
## 11. Evidence Levels

Evidence MUST 使用統一層級：

- `E0_NONE`
- `E1_DOCUMENTED`
- `E2_SOURCE_PRESENT`
- `E3_IMPLEMENTATION_DIFF`
- `E4_TEST_VERIFIED`
- `E5_DEPLOYED`
- `E6_PRODUCTION_VERIFIED`

低層 Evidence MUST_NOT 冒充高層 Evidence。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S012 -->
## 12. Evidence 必填欄位

正式 Evidence SHOULD 至少包含：

- Evidence UID
- Target UID
- Evidence Type
- Source Revision ID
- Environment
- Timestamp
- Result
- Artifact / Reference
- Generated By
- Verification Method

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S013 -->
## 13. PRE_WORK_AUDIT

每輪施工開始前 MUST 驗：

- Current Source Revision
- Active Work Unit
- Canonical UID
- Canonical Name
- Owner File
- Current Status
- Last PASS Gate
- Current Blocker
- Exact Next Action
- Duplicate State
- Conflict State

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S014 -->
## 14. WORK_UNIT_AUDIT

Work Unit Closure 前 MUST 稽核：

- Authority
- Naming
- Design
- Contract
- Implementation
- Runtime
- Data
- Permission
- API / Entry
- Error Handling
- Audit Logging
- Tests
- Regression
- Evidence
- Known Gaps
- Duplicate Guard
- Second-System Guard
- Conflict Guard
- Orphan Guard
- Stub Guard

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S015 -->
## 15. MODULE_AUDIT

Module Closure 前 MUST 稽核：

- Pages / Entries
- Components
- Controls
- Actions
- APIs
- Runtimes
- Data Objects
- Permissions
- Assets
- Tests
- Cross-unit Flow
- Shared Dependencies

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S016 -->
## 16. SYSTEM_AUDIT

完整系統稽核 MUST 跨 Module 檢查：

- Architecture
- Navigation
- Business Flow
- Shared Runtime
- Authentication
- Authorization
- Data Layer
- Async Runtime
- External Integrations
- Audit / Logging
- Monitoring
- Backup
- Rollback

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S017 -->
## 17. Naming Audit

MUST 檢查：

- Canonical UID Unique
- Canonical Name Unique
- Owner File Unique
- Alias Correct
- Deprecated Name Correct
- File Name Consistent
- Code Name Consistent
- Display Name 不影響 UID
- Broken Reference = 0

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S018 -->
## 18. Duplicate Audit

至少 MUST 掃描：

- Duplicate Page / Entry
- Duplicate Component
- Duplicate Control Meaning
- Duplicate Action
- Duplicate API
- Duplicate Runtime
- Duplicate Data Entity
- Duplicate Permission
- Duplicate Asset Owner
- Duplicate Test Owner
- Duplicate Migration Intent

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S019 -->
## 19. Second-System Audit

MUST 檢查是否存在：

- Legacy + Current 同時 Effectful
- 多個 Runtime 同功能
- 多個 API / Entry 同功能
- 多個 Data Truth Store 競爭
- 多套 Permission System
- 多套 Navigation Authority
- 多套 Registry Authority

任何 Critical 雙軌 MUST FAIL Release Gate。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S020 -->
## 20. Conflict Audit

至少 MUST 檢查：

- Authority Conflict
- Naming Conflict
- UID Conflict
- Owner Conflict
- Design Conflict
- Route Conflict
- Action Conflict
- API Conflict
- Runtime Conflict
- Data Conflict
- Permission Conflict
- State Conflict
- Migration Conflict
- Version Conflict

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S021 -->
## 21. Orphan Audit

MUST 檢查：

- Page without Entry
- Entry without Page/Capability
- Control without Action
- Action without Runtime
- Runtime without Owner
- Runtime without Test
- API without Permission
- Data Object without Runtime Owner
- Permission without Enforcement
- Asset without Usage
- Test without Capability
- Evidence without Revision

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S022 -->
## 22. Dead Code Audit

MUST 檢查未引用的正式舊：

- Component
- Entry
- Runtime
- Adapter
- Permission
- Mapping
- Data Object

應確認其狀態是否為 ACTIVE、DEPRECATED、READ_ONLY 或 REMOVED。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S022A -->
## 22A. Classification / Residual Audit

正式稽核 MUST 包含分類治理檢查：

- Canonical Owner Unique
- Source-to-Target Mapping Complete
- Exact Duplicate
- Semantic Duplicate
- Mixed Responsibility File
- Broken Reference
- Orphan File
- Dead File
- Second-System Conflict
- Unjustified Residual File
- Audit Metric Consistency

對 Mixed File 的結果 MUST 區分：

- Found
- Split
- Mixed Allowed
- Unresolved

不得僅以 `mixed_files_found = 0` 作為唯一成功條件。

分類治理完成至少要求：

- `UNMAPPED_REQUIRED_CONTENT = 0`
- `LOST_REQUIRED_CONTENT = 0`
- `CRITICAL_DUPLICATE = 0`
- `UNRESOLVED_CRITICAL_MIXED_FILE = 0`
- `BROKEN_REFERENCE = 0`
- `SECOND_SYSTEM_CONFLICT = 0`
- `CRITICAL_ORPHAN = 0`
- `UNJUSTIFIED_RESIDUAL_FILES = 0`
- `AUDIT_METRIC_CONFLICT = 0`
- `MIXED_TERMINAL_UNITS = 0`
- `UNRESOLVED_CONTAINER_UNITS = 0`

此稽核不是 Stage-1 專用。Stage-01～Stage-11 每一階段都 MUST 重新驗證本階段的 Terminal Unit 是否為語義同質單元。Audit MUST_NOT 接受「檔案已拆、物件已分層、測試已分組、部署已分批」作為充分證據；必須證明每個 Terminal Unit 的 Owner/Lifecycle/Approval/Version/Test-or-Acceptance/Stage Identity 一致，或具有完整 `MIXED_ALLOWED` 證據。任何 mixed terminal、未解析 container、parent-child responsibility loss、duplicate 或 remap shrinkage MUST fail-closed。

檔案數、壓縮檔大小、程式行數或 Commit 數 MUST_NOT 被視為分類完成度本身。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S023 -->
## 23. Blueprint Audit

正式施工前 SHOULD 確認：

- Scope
- Naming Registry
- Module Registry
- Page / Capability Registry
- Architecture
- Navigation
- User Flow
- State Machine
- Design System
- Page Design
- Asset Registry
- Visual Approval
- Audit Baseline
- Acceptance Matrix
- Design Freeze

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S024 -->
## 24. Visual Audit

至少 MUST 確認：

- Current Canonical Visual Unique
- Asset Binding Correct
- Locked Asset 未漂移
- Layout Match
- Component Match
- Control Position Match
- Typography Match
- Spacing Match
- Responsive Match
- Unapproved Drift = 0

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S025 -->
## 25. Frontend Audit

逐 Page / Entry SHOULD 驗：

- Route / Entry
- Render
- Layout
- Components
- Controls
- Fields
- Loading
- Empty
- Error
- Disabled
- Permission Visibility
- Responsive
- Localization
- Accessibility

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S026 -->
## 26. Backend / Runtime Audit

MUST 依適用範圍檢查：

- Runtime Owner
- Input Validation
- Authentication Context
- Authorization
- Business Rules
- State Transition
- Idempotency
- Transaction
- Concurrency
- Error Handling
- Audit
- Output Contract

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S027 -->
## 27. API / Entry Audit

每個正式 Entry SHOULD 確認：

- UID
- Route / Method / Entry Type
- Contract
- Request Schema
- Response Schema
- Authentication
- Permission
- Validation
- Runtime
- Data / Provider
- Error
- Audit
- Tests

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S028 -->
## 28. Database Audit

至少 MUST 檢查：

- Migration IDs
- Schema
- Data Objects
- Relationships
- Indexes
- Unique Rules
- Constraints
- Data Security
- Production Applied State

Migration Source File 存在不得視為 Production Applied。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S029 -->
## 29. Permission Audit

至少 MUST 驗：

- UI Visibility（如適用）
- Trusted Runtime Authorization
- Data Layer Enforcement（如適用）
- Authorized Case
- Unauthorized Case
- Wrong-owner / Wrong-scope Case（如適用）

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S030 -->
## 30. Async Runtime Audit

如適用 MUST 驗：

- Queue / Trigger Bound
- Job Created
- Consumer Bound
- Execution
- Retry
- Failure State
- Dead-letter Handling
- Result Persisted
- Caller / UI Updated

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S031 -->
## 31. External Integration Audit

如適用 MUST 驗：

- Adapter
- Credential
- Environment
- Real Request
- Real Response
- Timeout
- Retry
- Failure Handling
- Audit

沒有 Required Real Integration Evidence 不得 Production PASS。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S032 -->
## 32. Security Audit

依適用風險 MUST 檢查：

- Authentication
- Authorization
- Data Policy
- Secret Exposure
- Injection
- Script Injection
- Request Forgery
- Unsafe Upload
- Abuse Control
- Session Security
- Temporary Bypass

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S033 -->
## 33. Test Audit

Test Audit MUST 區分：

- Unit
- Integration
- API / Entry
- Database
- Permission
- Browser
- End-to-End
- Production

不得用某一層大量 PASS 取代其他 Required Test Layer。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S034 -->
## 34. Build Audit

確認：

- Static Validation
- Type / Schema Validation
- Production Build
- Startup
- Required Runtime Bundles
- Entry Generation

Build PASS 只證明 Build Gate。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S035 -->
## 35. Deployment Audit

確認：

- Expected Source Revision
- Actual Source Revision
- Release ID
- Build ID
- Deployment ID
- Environment
- Status
- Timestamp

Expected Revision 與 Actual Deployment Revision 不一致 MUST FAIL。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S036 -->
## 36. Production Audit

Production Audit MUST 直接驗正式環境：

- Production Entry Point
- Production Revision
- Health
- Readiness
- Authentication
- Session
- Navigation
- Pages
- Controls
- Runtime
- Data
- Permission
- Async Runtime
- Required External Integrations
- Localization
- Responsive
- Visual Fidelity
- Monitoring

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S037 -->
## 37. Backup / Rollback Audit

如適用 MUST 驗：

- Backup Coverage
- Retention
- Last Successful Backup
- Restore Procedure
- Previous Stable Release
- Rollback Path
- Data Compatibility
- Rollback Verification

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S038 -->
## 38. Progress 不得依感覺

所有百分比 MUST 有固定分母。

MUST_NOT 使用「大約」、「差不多」、「接近完成」替代可計算結果。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S039 -->
## 39. Work Unit 完成度

公式：

`WORK_UNIT_COMPLETENESS = PASSED_REQUIRED_AUDIT_ITEMS / TOTAL_REQUIRED_AUDIT_ITEMS * 100`

只計同一 Work Unit 的 Required Audit Items。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S040 -->
## 40. Module 完成度

預設公式：

`MODULE_COMPLETENESS = CLOSED_REQUIRED_WORK_UNITS / TOTAL_REQUIRED_WORK_UNITS * 100`

若使用權重，Weight MUST 在施工前固定於 Authority，MUST_NOT 事後調整。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S041 -->
## 41. Implementation Completeness

Implementation Completeness SHOULD 依：

- Design Freeze
- Contract
- Frontend
- Runtime
- Data
- Permission
- Integrations
- Required Tests

計算。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S042 -->
## 42. Production Readiness

Production Readiness MUST 使用 Production Required Gates 為分母，至少包括適用的：

- Release Gate
- Production Configuration
- Production Migration
- Production Deployment
- Production Smoke
- Production Browser Acceptance
- Production Data Acceptance
- Required External Integration Acceptance
- Monitoring
- Backup
- Rollback

Source Implementation 100% 不等於 Production Readiness 100%。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S043 -->
## 43. Blocked 計算規則

Required Item 若 BLOCKED，仍屬未 PASS。

報告 MAY 額外提供：

- Internal Implementation Completeness
- External Blocked Count
- Production Readiness

但不得將 Blocked 從分母偷偷移除。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S044 -->
## 44. 禁止重複計分

同一 Capability 的：

- File Created
- Implementation Added
- Test PASS
- Deployment PASS

屬不同 Gate，不得當成多個完整功能重複計分。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S045 -->
## 45. 進度可以倒退

如果新 Evidence 推翻舊 PASS，對應狀態 MUST 降為：

- REVERIFY_REQUIRED
- PARTIAL
- FAIL
- BLOCKED

百分比 MAY 下降。

MUST_NOT 為了報表好看保留失效 PASS。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S046 -->
## 46. Blocker Ledger

每個 Blocker MUST 記錄：

- Blocker UID
- Target UID
- Severity
- Opened At
- Owner
- Reason
- Impact
- Unlock Condition
- Current Status
- Resolved Evidence

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S047 -->
## 47. Gap Ledger

每個已知 Gap MUST 記錄：

- Gap UID
- Target UID
- Category
- Severity
- Owner
- Evidence
- Required Fix
- Status

Gap MUST_NOT 只存在聊天文字而不進正式狀態。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S048 -->
## 48. Regression Ledger

共用 Owner 修改後 SHOULD 記錄：

- Affected Work Units
- Required Regression Tests
- PASS
- FAIL
- Pending
- Current Revision

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S049 -->
## 49. Current State Ledger

專案 SHOULD 維持單一 Current State，至少保存：

- Current Source Revision
- Current Release
- Current Production Revision
- Active Work Unit
- Last Closed Work Unit
- Open Critical Gaps
- Open Blockers
- Implementation Completeness
- Production Readiness

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S050 -->
## 50. Resume Ledger

至少保存：

- Current Work Unit
- Current Step
- Last PASS Gate
- Current FAIL Gate
- Current Blocker
- Exact Next Action
- Current Source Revision

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S051 -->
## 51. Progress Report 必填區塊

每份正式進度報告 MUST 包含：

### A. Current Truth

- Current Source Revision
- Current Release
- Current Production Revision
- Environment
- Active Work Unit
- Last Closed Work Unit
- Current Gate

### B. Actual Execution

只列實際：

- Modified
- Created Required Artifact
- Removed Duplicate / Obsolete Artifact
- Migration
- Tests
- Build
- Deployment
- Production Verification

閱讀、搜尋、分析、規劃不得列入施工成果。

### C. Evidence

每個完成宣稱 MUST 附 Evidence Reference。

### D. Completeness

至少報：

- Active Work Unit %
- Module %
- Implementation Completeness %
- Production Readiness %

### E. Open Gaps

- Missing Gate
- Missing Dependency
- Failed Test
- Known Gap
- Blocker

### F. Guards

- Duplicate Guard
- Second-System Guard
- Conflict Guard
- Orphan Guard
- Stub Guard

### G. Closure

- Active Work Unit: CLOSED / NOT_CLOSED
- Closure Reason

### H. Resume Point

- Next Work Unit
- Next Gate
- Exact Next Action

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S052 -->

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S055 -->
## 55. Final Acceptance Checklist

正式宣告可上線使用前 MUST 確認適用的 Required Gate：

- Authority PASS
- Naming PASS
- Duplicate Guard PASS
- Second-System Guard PASS
- Conflict Guard PASS
- Orphan Guard PASS
- Stub Guard PASS
- Design Freeze PASS
- Visual Regression PASS
- Frontend PASS
- Control PASS
- Runtime PASS
- API / Entry PASS
- Data PASS
- Migration PASS
- Authentication PASS
- Authorization PASS
- Data Security PASS
- External Integration PASS
- Async Runtime PASS
- Required Tests PASS
- Production Build PASS
- Production Deployment PASS
- Production Revision Match PASS
- Production Smoke PASS
- Production Browser PASS
- Production Data PASS
- Monitoring PASS
- Backup PASS
- Rollback PASS
- Critical Severity 0

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S056 -->
## 56. PROJECT_COMPLETE 定義

只有以下全部成立才可標示：

`PROJECT_COMPLETE`

以及：

`PRODUCTION_READY`

條件：

- All Required Scope Work Units = CLOSED
- All Required Production Gates = PASS
- Critical Duplicate = 0
- Critical Conflict = 0
- Parallel Production Runtime = 0
- Critical Orphan = 0
- Critical Stub = 0
- Critical Gap = 0
- Production Evidence = VERIFIED

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S057 -->
## 57. 稽核後修復規則

如果工作模式是 `AUDIT_ONLY`：

MUST 只讀、驗證、記錄，不得修改 Product Authority 或 Implementation。

如果工作模式是 `AUDIT_AND_FIX`：

MUST 使用：

`AUDIT -> GAP_LIST -> PRIORITIZE -> FIX_ONE -> TEST -> REAUDIT -> CLOSE -> NEXT`

MUST_NOT 對所有問題同時各修一點。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S058 -->
## 58. 週期性報告規則

週期性進度報告 MUST 僅計入有 Evidence 的成果。

固定分類 SHOULD 為：

- VERIFIED_COMPLETIONS
- PARTIAL_OR_IN_PROGRESS
- BLOCKED_OR_FAILED

未執行的討論、建議、規劃不得進 VERIFIED_COMPLETIONS。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S059 -->
## 59. 禁止回報行為

MUST_NOT：

- 隱藏 FAIL。
- 隱藏 Blocker。
- 沿用未驗證舊百分比。
- 以活動量代替進度。
- 以低層 Evidence 冒充 Production Evidence。
- 把 Deployment Success 說成 Production Ready。
- 把 PARTIAL 說成 COMPLETE。
- 因報表需要而調整分母。
- 將 Blocked Required Item 從分母移除。



<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S059A -->
## 59A. Source Truth / Contamination Audit

正式 Audit MUST 增加 `SOURCE_TRUTH_AUDIT`，至少檢查：

- Raw Source 已登錄。
- Source Hash / Revision 可追溯。
- Current Authority Membership 已解析。
- Canonical UID / Owner 已解析。
- Superseded / Historical / Generated Source 未冒充 Current。
- Contradicting Source 已裁決。
- Source-to-Target Mapping 完整。
- Current Owner 無混入未裁決舊內容。

完成條件：

- `UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_TRUTH = 0`
- `CURRENT_SOURCE_CONTAMINATION = 0`
- `AUTHORITY_CONFLICT = 0`

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S059B -->
## 59B. Full Lifecycle Page Audit

每個正式 Page MUST 具有 `PAGE_LIFECYCLE_AUDIT`，固定檢查從 Source Intake 至 Production Closure 的每個 Required Step。

Audit Matrix 每列至少 MUST 增加：

- lifecycle_step
- upstream_evidence_ref
- downstream_evidence_ref
- step_revision
- skipped
- skip_reason

任何 REQUIRED Step：

- `skipped = true` → FAIL
- Evidence 不屬於 Current Revision → `REVERIFY_REQUIRED`
- 只有下游 Evidence、沒有上游來源 → FAIL

Page End-to-End 完成度 MUST 使用：

`PASSED_REQUIRED_LIFECYCLE_STEPS / TOTAL_REQUIRED_LIFECYCLE_STEPS * 100`

不得以已施工功能數取代。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S059C -->
## 59C. Functional Chain Audit

每個正式功能 MUST 逐鏈稽核：

- Intent
- Preconditions
- Entry
- Input Source
- Trigger / Control
- Gate
- Permission
- Action
- Validation
- Payload
- API / Entry
- Runtime
- Repository / Data / Provider
- Audit Event
- Response / Feedback
- Success State
- Next State / Step / Gate
- Failure / Recovery / Rollback
- Terminal Outcome

功能鏈結果 MUST 可統計：

- COMPLETE
- AUTO_REMEDIABLE
- IMPLEMENTATION_GAP
- SHARED_OWNER_REFERENCE
- INPUT_SOURCE_GAP
- AUTHORITY_GAP
- ARCHITECTURE_GAP
- INTENTIONAL_FAIL_CLOSED
- TEST_ONLY_BEHAVIOR

任何 Required 功能只要有未關閉 Gap，該 Capability MUST_NOT PASS。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S059D -->
## 59D. Visual Geometry Audit

Visual Audit MUST 增加可量化 Geometry Evidence，而非只靠人工 Screenshot。

逐 Required Viewport 至少 MUST 記錄：

- viewport_uid
- viewport_width / height
- target_uid
- expected_geometry
- actual_geometry
- overlap_count
- clipping_count
- overflow_count
- occlusion_count
- unexpected_wrap_count
- text_overflow_count
- dimension_violation_count
- anchor_drift_count
- visual_diff_result

任何超出正式 Tolerance 的項目 MUST FAIL。

若自動微調，修正前後 Geometry Evidence MUST 同時保留，且受影響 Visual PASS 項目 MUST `REVERIFY_REQUIRED`。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S059E -->
## 59E. Deployment / Production Render Identity Audit

正式 Deployment Audit 除了 Deployment Status，MUST 同時記錄：

- expected_source_revision
- build_source_revision
- deployed_source_revision
- runtime_reported_revision
- build_id
- deployment_id
- route_manifest_hash
- client_asset_manifest_hash
- production_route_manifest_hash
- production_client_asset_manifest_hash
- dom_fingerprint
- expected_dom_fingerprint
- visual_geometry_result
- stale_release_fingerprint_detected

完成條件：

- Source / Build / Deployment / Runtime Revision 全部一致。
- Production Assets 屬於本次 Build。
- DOM Fingerprint 屬於本次 Candidate。
- Visual Geometry PASS。
- 舊 Release Fingerprint = 0。

只要平台 Deployment Success 但上述任一項不一致，狀態 MUST 為 FAIL，不得為 PASS 或 PARTIAL。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S059F -->
## 59F. Cross-page / System Slice Audit

SYSTEM_AUDIT 與 MODULE_AUDIT MUST 支援以 FLOW UID 建立 Slice Matrix。

每一跨頁 Slice MUST 驗：

- Source Capability PASS
- Exit Contract PASS
- Shared Dependency PASS
- Identity/Context Continuity PASS
- Permission Continuity PASS
- State Transition PASS
- Target Entry PASS
- Error/Retry/Resume PASS
- Audit Continuity PASS
- Production Browser E2E PASS（Required Flow）

跨頁功能不得以「兩個頁面各自 PASS」推論 Flow PASS。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S059G -->
## 59G. Complexity Coverage Audit

治理規範本身的有效性驗證 MUST 至少覆蓋不同 Complexity Profile 的代表性 Work Unit。

最低建議覆蓋：

- 一個 P1/P2 頁面。
- 一個 P3 Effectful 頁面。
- 一個 P4 Cross-page 頁面或 Flow。
- 若系統存在 P5/P6，至少各一個代表性 Scope。

此要求是「規範驗證覆蓋率」，不是允許頁面抽樣驗收。正式產品 Page 仍必須逐頁完成自己的 Required Gate。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S060 -->
## 60. 文件完成條件

本文件持續有效於整個專案生命週期。

只有 Final Acceptance Checklist 全部符合後，稽核才可輸出：

`PRODUCTION_READY = TRUE`


<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S066 -->
## 66. v2.1.0 Current-run Evidence Audit

Audit MUST 顯示本次 `run_uid`、Execution Cycle、Source Revision、開始/結束時間與 Terminal Status。沒有 Current-run Evidence 的 PASS MUST 降級為 `NOT_VERIFIED` 或 `REVERIFY_REQUIRED`。

Immutable predecessor package bytes MAY preserve their historical state, but a successor closure candidate MUST NOT carry a superseded `PENDING`, `GITHUB_REPLAY_PENDING`, or `REVERIFY_PENDING` claim for a replay/test that already has verified Current Evidence. The successor MUST bind the exact run/evidence identity and terminal result. Human formal approval `PENDING` is a separate review state and MUST NOT be auto-converted to PASS by machine evidence.

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S067 -->
## 67. v2.1.0 Source Truth Recalculation Audit

Audit MUST 從 Source Records 重新計算 Current Positive Owner、Conflict、Contamination、Supersession Coverage；MUST_NOT 只讀來源檔自己填寫的 `metrics=0`。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S061 -->
## 61. v2.1.0 Geometry Measurement Audit

Geometry PASS MUST 來自 Browser DOM Measurement 或等價可驗證 Runtime Capture，並逐項比較 Expected Geometry / Actual Geometry / Tolerance。

人工填 `overlap_count=0`、`dimension_violation_count=0` 或 `visual_diff_result=PASS` 而沒有 measurement source / capture evidence MUST_NOT PASS。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S062 -->
## 62. v2.1.0 Complex Flow Audit

有 Stage/State Machine 的頁面 MUST 稽核 legal transition coverage、illegal transition rejection、recovery/retry、idempotency、async result provenance。

僅逐按鈕 PASS 不等於 Stage Machine PASS；單頁 PASS 不等於 Cross-page Flow PASS。

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S063 -->
## 63. v2.1.0 Version Reporting

進度報告 MUST 使用目前治理套件版本。自 `v2.1.0` 起，Patch 只到 9；下一版進位 Minor。舊 `v1.1.0` 僅為歷史測試包，不得再作 Current Governance Version。


## v2.1.0 Pilot Hardening — Multi-representation Authority / Machine Encoding Mirror

- The same conceptual Authority MAY exist as a human-readable design document and a machine-readable encoding only when exactly one canonical editable owner is declared.
- A machine encoding, generated mirror, snapshot, export, or compiled representation MUST declare `canonical_owner_ref`; machine mirrors MUST also provide current semantic synchronization evidence.
- A mirror MUST_NOT become a second positive editable Authority merely because it says `FINAL`, `LOCKED`, `CURRENT`, has a newer file timestamp, or contains more fields.
- Human document ↔ machine encoding drift MUST block construction until reconciled to the declared owner; filename suffixes, upload dates and embedded `derived_validation: PASS` are not proof of current truth.
- Embedded self-validation / derived-validation inside an Authority file is provenance only and MUST_NOT satisfy a current validation-run Gate.

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S068 -->
## 68. Governance Stage Lock / Anti-Moving-Target Audit

Governance audit MUST distinguish three things: immutable baseline, mutable bugfix candidate, and locked released governance.

For every stage test, Audit MUST verify:

- original `v2.1.0` baseline hash remains unchanged;
- candidate normative aggregate hash is captured before test execution;
- candidate normative aggregate hash is identical at run closure;
- allowed changes are limited to defect UIDs declared before the bugfix window;
- no later lifecycle-stage feature was mixed into the current-stage bugfix;
- fixture inputs contain observable facts, not validator-directed expected outcomes;
- fixture self-declared PASS/COMPLETE values do not satisfy a Gate without recomputation;
- Page Construction extraction and Visual Construction extraction are independent physical artifacts and independent editable owners;
- locked stage content has not been edited after release;
- next-stage validation did not begin before current-stage release lock;
- website reconstruction has not begun before governance release final lock.

Any normative hash mutation during an active frozen test MUST invalidate the test run. The operator MUST NOT edit the rules and continue the same run.

If a new governance defect is discovered after a stage release lock, Audit MUST preserve the locked release, create a new defect record, and require a new candidate/version plus regression of every impacted earlier stage. Existing extracted/page artifacts affected by the new rule MUST become `REVERIFY_REQUIRED`; they MUST_NOT be silently grandfathered.

A governance stage may be reported PASS only when the test run, candidate hash, defect ledger, and release lock all refer to the same immutable candidate content.

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S069 -->
## 69. Stage-1 Classified Extraction / Base Blueprint Audit

Stage-1 audit MUST verify physical source-to-classification-to-blueprint lineage, not filename presence alone.

The audit MUST recompute:

- every required source segment has one legal disposition;
- every current classification artifact has one responsibility scope and one Canonical Owner unless `MIXED_ALLOWED` proof is complete;
- Page and Visual responsibilities do not share the same editable owner/path;
- Base Blueprint consumes only current classified artifact refs/shared refs, never Raw Source directly after classification closure;
- Base Blueprint input hashes equal current classification artifact hashes;
- no classification payload is duplicated into the Base Blueprint as a second owner;
- all current output files are referenced by the current run manifest;
- previous-run output, temp files, backups, caches, abandoned split files and unexplained residuals equal zero.

A Stage-1 result MUST be reported `FAIL` when any required source content remains unclassified/unmapped/multi-mapped/lost, any required responsibility is missing from the Base Blueprint, or any residual current artifact cannot be explained by the current run manifest.

File count, folder count, presence of a large `PAGE_CONSTRUCTION` file, or a self-declared `PASS` MUST_NOT be accepted as evidence that classified materialization or Base Blueprint construction is complete.

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S070 -->
## 70. Full-Source Coverage / Dual-Blueprint Audit

Audit MUST compare the Source Structure Manifest against the Source Segment Map and classification lineage. A source may be reported fully extracted only when every `REQUIRED` source node has one legal disposition and no required node is absent.

Audit MUST distinguish:

- `FULL_SOURCE_ENUMERATION_PROVEN`
- `PARTIAL_SOURCE_ENUMERATION_PILOT`
- `SOURCE_ENUMERATION_NOT_PROVEN`

Only the first may satisfy full Source Intake closure.

For each Page, Audit MUST find exactly one current `PAGE_BASE_BLUEPRINT`, exactly one current `VISUAL_BASE_BLUEPRINT`, and one current binding manifest that references both current hashes. A combined Page+Visual editable blueprint MUST fail the ownership audit.



<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S064 -->
## 64. Program Naming / Reference Binding Audit

Audit MUST verify that every Current program source file is pre-registered before implementation and matches its Program Artifact UID, canonical path/filename, owner UID, Construction Profile and current hash.

Audit MUST verify that each Implementation Manifest resolves all required normative refs, input artifact refs, dependency refs, acceptance audit blueprint refs and required tests. An unresolved or invented reference is BLOCKED.

Framework-reserved filenames are PASS only when their registered canonical path and owner identity match exactly.

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S065 -->
## 65. Continuity / Cleanup / Residual Audit

Audit MUST recompute forward and reverse dependency continuity across layers, stages and pages. Required producer/consumer edges missing either direction are FAIL.

For every supersession transaction, Audit MUST prove zero Current references to the superseded owner and zero unmanaged duplicate/temp/backup/obsolete artifact before closure.

Required metrics are at least: `current_reference_to_superseded_owner`, `duplicate_current_owner`, `orphan_required_artifact`, `unjustified_residual_file`, and `broken_reference`; all MUST equal zero for closure.
<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S071 -->
## 71. Acceptance Audit Blueprint / Compiled Baseline Closed Loop

Acceptance requirements MUST be planned before implementation in a canonical `GOVERNANCE_ACCEPTANCE_AUDIT_BLUEPRINT` or page/scope equivalent. The blueprint owns the audit denominator, required audit item UIDs, acceptance conditions, validator bindings, required evidence, required tests, N/A authority policy, reviewer requirements, and closure conditions.

`AUDIT_BASELINE` MUST be compiler-generated from the current Acceptance Audit Blueprint plus current normative source hashes. It MUST_NOT be maintained as a second manually edited acceptance authority.

Audit Matrix and Review Progress MUST reference the same acceptance blueprint UID/revision/hash and audit item UIDs. If the blueprint hash changes, prior PASS/APPROVED results for affected items MUST become `REVERIFY_REQUIRED`.

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S072 -->
## 72. Management Registry Audit

Formal governance test MUST verify physical Current instances for Naming Registry, Blueprint Registry, Audit Catalog, Review Progress Ledger, Lifecycle Stage Registry, Acceptance Audit Blueprint, Section Number Registry, Protected Current Artifact Registry, Root Manifest, and Construction Artifact Index.

Missing registry, duplicate current registry, stale hash, unresolved canonical path, or schema mismatch MUST be a blocking governance-definition defect.

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S073 -->
## 73. Pre-formal Multidirection Stress Audit

Before formal freeze, governance MUST pass destructive mutation tests covering at minimum: missing required artifacts, wrong section reference, duplicate section number, unsafe cleanup deletion, broken forward/reverse dependency, cross-page page_uid drift, source lineage drift, unresolved shared ref, stale hash, unregistered program file, invalid stage transition, N/A misuse, duplicate owner, residual backup/temp/old file, and baseline/blueprint divergence.

A mutation test counts only when the target validator detects the semantic violation; failure caused solely by an unrelated mirror/hash mismatch MUST_NOT be counted as proof of the intended guard.

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S074 -->
## 74. Governance Load / UID Resolution / Write-Target Audit

Audit MUST prove that every executed item has a current `GOVERNANCE_LOAD_RECEIPT` created before execution and bound to the exact governance revision/hash used by that run. Missing, stale, post-hoc, or mismatched receipts are FAIL.

Audit MUST verify that the effective normative set includes the mandatory common bundles plus the exact Stage, Construction Profile, artifact-specific, and dependency-closure normative refs applicable to the item. Loading only item-specific rules while omitting common construction governance is FAIL.

Audit MUST recompute each Section UID resolution against the Current Section Registry and Root Manifest. Each UID must resolve to exactly one document/anchor under the expected current document hash. Fuzzy/heading-only resolution or substitution is FAIL.

For every write, Audit MUST prove `Program Artifact UID -> canonical target path/filename -> owner -> Work Unit -> expected pre-write hash`. A write to a different registered artifact, a normative document, or an unregistered path is FAIL even when the target file itself is otherwise valid.


Pre-formal acceptance MUST execute the complete registered destructive regression matrix on every run; the presence, checksum, or historical PASS claim of a suite is not execution evidence. Exact denominators and expected blocked/pass counts MUST be machine-checked, and any omitted suite, timeout, invalid JSON result, changed denominator, or failed expectation is a blocking failure.

The final candidate trust decision MUST be anchored outside the candidate package. Candidate-local compiler, Root Manifest refresh, checksum regeneration, or validator edits MUST_NOT be able to update the external trust root. Formal Freeze eligibility requires an external immutable package hash-set verification before candidate-local validators are accepted.
### Test Runner Isolation / Collection-Safety Contract

Governance regression assets that are registered as standalone subprocess/JSON executables MUST be isolated from generic test-runner collection. A collector such as pytest MUST_NOT import and execute a standalone regression body as a side effect of test discovery, and collection MUST_NOT trigger `SystemExit`, process termination, mutation, external-trust evaluation, or acceptance-result emission from those standalone assets.

Every standalone regression asset MUST declare an explicit collection-isolation guard before its executable body. Standalone exit status remains legal only for direct execution by the registered governance regression runner. Generic pytest collection is diagnostic only and MUST_NOT substitute for the mandatory regression subprocess matrix.

The Current package MUST carry a machine-readable Test Runner Isolation Contract defining the standalone runner, pytest collection policy, configuration path, and collector contract test. `pytest` INTERNALERROR, collector-triggered `SystemExit`, accidental execution of a standalone regression during discovery, missing collection isolation, or runner-mode ambiguity is a blocking governance-definition defect.

A missing external execution precondition (for example the external immutable trust root required by Pre-formal) MUST remain fail-closed for the applicable acceptance run, but MUST_NOT be misreported as a pytest collection crash. Runner/collector failure and governance semantic failure are separate evidence classes and MUST remain distinguishable.

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S075 -->
## 75. Stage Test Defect Ledger / Spec Evolution / Source-Control Single-Authority Audit

Audit MUST verify that every Stage test produces a complete defect/gap ledger covering all defects discovered during execution, including defects not anticipated by the original test plan. Every record MUST include evidence, affected artifact or runtime identity, defect class, scope class (`GLOBAL_SHARED` or `STAGE_LOCAL`), disposition, blocking state, and the governance revision that resolves or preserves it. Missing records, silent omission, or closing a Stage while a discovered blocking defect has no disposition is FAIL.

Audit MUST compare construction/production output against the Current governance revision after test execution. For every mismatch, Audit MUST prove either an implementation correction or a governance-spec correction with explicit Authority. A `GLOBAL_SHARED` defect is PASS only when all affected governance layers have been updated and regression-protected; a `STAGE_LOCAL` defect is PASS only when it remains Stage-scoped unless evidence proves cross-stage recurrence.

Before version promotion, Audit MUST verify multidirection/high-pressure regression against the patched candidate. After promotion to the next `v2.1.X`, Audit MUST run predecessor backtrace regression against the immediately preceding version and then rerun the complete Current governance validation. Historical PASS receipts MAY support provenance but MUST_NOT substitute for those Current-version executions.

Source-Control governance audit MUST verify exactly one Current governance entry through the configured Single-Spec Authority adapter. The entry MUST identify the frozen Current governance version, canonical spec-content hash, package SHA256, current status, and adapter identity. The canonical entry path is adapter-defined; provider-specific paths are profile data, not common governance semantics. Historical Stage correction packages and evidence files MUST remain history/evidence only. More than one Current version pointer, a stale adapter Current version after freeze, or Current promotion before predecessor backtrace plus full revalidation is a blocking authority divergence.

A Stage is eligible for Formal Freeze and next-stage testing only when: defect/gap recording is complete, production conformance review is complete, scope classification is complete, all required shared/stage-local spec repairs are complete, multidirection high-pressure testing passes, the `v2.1.X` version is promoted, versioned candidate evidence is synchronized through the configured Source-Control adapter, predecessor backtrace passes, full Current validation passes, the single Source-Control Current authority is promoted, and no unwaived blocking governance defect remains.


<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S076 -->
## 76. Product-Neutral Binding / Business Entity Lifecycle Completeness Audit

Audit MUST prove that the common governance package is not bound to a specific product. Normative Mother Specs and common invariant registries MUST NOT require a product name, product-only Page UID, route, repository, provider, database schema, department, or runtime identity. Product-specific strings MAY exist only in explicitly labeled provenance, synthetic fixtures, compatibility aliases, or Product Profile extensions that cannot weaken common invariants.

Audit MUST enumerate every governed Business Entity for every required Page/Surface/Module/Workflow and compare the Entity Inventory against Source Authority. It MUST then audit every entity against its Operation Matrix and every relationship against the Hierarchy Matrix. Missing entities, silently omitted operations, unauthorised `NOT_APPLICABLE`, list-only child entities, create-only lifecycle truncation, missing revision/version disposition, unresolved category/chapter/item relationships, or missing parent/child bindings are blocking failures.

Audit MUST verify bidirectional coverage for every required entity operation: operation-to-interaction-to-action-to-payload-to-runtime-to-state/audit, and visible interaction back to an allowed operation. Orphan Controls, orphan Actions, orphan Runtime endpoints, or required operations with no user/system entry are failures.

Completeness denominators MUST be derived from the authoritative set of `Business Entity × Applicable REQUIRED Operation` plus required hierarchy edges. Page/Control/Action/API/Port counts MAY be diagnostic metrics but MUST_NOT be accepted as functional completeness evidence.

Before Formal Freeze, a binding audit MUST confirm that product-specific examples can be replaced by a different Product Profile without changing common Mother Spec semantics, common invariant keys, lifecycle-stage semantics, acceptance rules, or validator logic. Failure of that substitution test is a common-governance binding defect.

Audit MUST review every automatic functional addition against a `FUNCTION_ADMISSION_SCORECARD` and `AUTO_COMPLETION_SCOPE_LEDGER`. It MUST distinguish `REQUIRED_AUTO_COMPLETION_ELIGIBLE`, `REVIEW_ONLY_OPTIONAL`, and `REJECT_REDUNDANT_OR_SCOPE_EXPANSION`. Audit MUST verify that score evidence is reproducible and that no score was used to override an Authority gap, ambiguity, existing equivalent capability, or unsupported product-scope expansion.

Audit MUST prove bounded completion: every added node/edge traces to a seed gap or REQUIRED operation; every transitive dependency has independent admission evidence; all additions remain inside the frozen dependency closure; no generic CRUD/sibling symmetry expansion occurred; no dependency cycle exists; and automation stopped once the minimal required closure was reached. Any denominator growth without Authority trace is `UNAUTHORIZED_SCOPE_EXPANSION`.

Audit MUST also compare logic and visual completion. For each user-visible or user-observable REQUIRED operation, the `FUNCTION_VISUAL_IMPACT_MATRIX` MUST resolve the approved visual surface/control, state binding, pending/disabled behavior, success/error/recovery feedback, applicable revision/version visibility, responsive/overflow behavior, i18n/accessibility bindings, and visual Authority. Logic-only completion of a user-facing function and visual-only controls without an allowed operation are both blocking.

Validation-performance audit MUST report files read, bytes read, parse count, cache hits/misses, full-package copy count, impacted validator set, and elapsed time when indexed validation is used. Indexing is a performance mechanism, not an acceptance shortcut. Before Formal Freeze, Audit MUST run an index-drift full sweep and block if indexed and full-sweep results diverge.


<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S077 -->
## 77. Functional Workbench / Interaction Topology / AI Continuity Audit

Audit MUST verify that every contiguous governed journey has a `FUNCTIONAL_WORKBENCH_CONTRACT` and `INTERACTION_TOPOLOGY_MATRIX`, and that every declared workbench class is supported by Authority. It MUST distinguish a complete set of individual controls/components from a coherent usable workflow. Functional presence without topology conformity is FAIL.

For each `ATOMIC_WORKBENCH`, Audit MUST verify required operation order, adjacency, same-surface placement, interruption boundaries, shared context/state identity, and responsive reflow. Unapproved placement of unrelated surfaces inside the atomic chain, or splitting required operations across independent panels/routes/tabs without an allowed separation contract, is a blocking `FUNCTIONAL_VISUAL_FRAGMENTATION` defect.

For `CROSS_SURFACE_FLOW`, Audit MUST verify transition identity and exact context handoff. A destination that restarts without required context, reconstructs state by inference, or loses base entity/version identity is FAIL. For `SAME_SURFACE_CLUSTER`, Audit MUST verify that spatial separation does not break the defined continuation relationship.

When the conditional AI-assisted interaction profile applies, Audit MUST verify conversation identity transitions, thread/context preservation or explicit fork semantics, same-baseline multi-agent input equivalence, the raw-output-to-authoritative formalization boundary, revision context continuity, and branch isolation/adoption. Silent conversation reset, participant baseline drift presented as comparable output, raw AI output promoted directly to canonical state, revision without exact base lineage, or branch output silently merged into mainline is FAIL.

Audit MUST compare Stage-02 functional topology against Stage-03 visual topology and Stage-05/06/10 execution evidence. Geometry may vary only within the approved responsive/reflow contract; semantic order, workbench cohesion, context continuity, and decision boundaries MUST remain equivalent. Any mismatch MUST reopen the owning Stage rather than being waived as a cosmetic difference.

<!-- SECTION_UID: WEB-GOV-04-S078 -->
## 78. Stage Execution Preflight / Effective Denominator / Remediation Continuity Audit

Stage acceptance MUST independently audit the execution model, not merely the final blocker count. The audit MUST prove:

- all required preflight manifests and the preflight receipt physically exist and bind the active Governance UID;
- all registered lifecycle Stage entries (`STAGE-01` through `STAGE-11`) explicitly bind the canonical Stage execution optimization invariant, with a required binding denominator of 11/11;
- every scanner, validator, trace builder and classifier that claims canonical coverage consumed the same `REQUIRED_FIELD_MANIFEST` and `CLASSIFICATION_RULESET`;
- the effective denominator was recomputed from immutable discovery plus exact legal successor/materialization overlay;
- applicability decisions precede blocker counting and include evidence for every `NOT_APPLICABLE` result;
- role-safe evidence boundaries were enforced and no adjacent signal/owner/event/field was promoted across contract roles without exact Authority;
- every `AUTO_REMEDIABLE` closure has one and only one viable role-correct minimal derivation inside the frozen dependency closure;
- every `AUTHORITY_GAP` records at least two materially distinct viable product behaviors, or is rejected as misclassified;
- dependency/root ordering was respected and no leaf was repeatedly reworked because an upstream shared contract was deferred;
- local incremental validations match the next checkpoint full sweep for the impacted signatures;
- one Current Problem Register and one append-only Resolution Ledger define Current issue state;
- generated outputs, including new untracked artifacts, were persisted correctly;
- harness/engine defects were repaired at the common engine and replayed before product progress was credited;
- a post-promotion retry contains no active completion credit from the superseded Stage attempt.

A mismatch between local and full-sweep results, a stale denominator, duplicate Current problem truth, missing generated output, cross-role evidence substitution, or reuse of pre-promotion Stage credit is blocking. Historical attempts MAY be retained for regression signatures and defect provenance only.
